**Unknown: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,496,630 applications during 2000–2025. The latest year, 2025, was the recorded peak, with 365,569 applications. Applications in 2025 were 520% higher than in 2019 (58,924). Applications in 2025 were 1,947% higher than in 2024 (17,859). In 2025, the leading destinations were United States (282,797; 77%), United Kingdom (64,052; 18%), Australia (6,704; 1.8%). United States received 77% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 4.3% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 38%, across 62,832 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 85% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 6.9 percentage points lower than in 2024 (45%). Unknown origin is a reporting category, not a nationality; its trend can reflect changes in recording as well as activity.
